# FAMILY03 C — successor-visible case facts

Verified formulation group P; complete calibrated 15-minute logger means are below 8.0 °C. The high-rate trace has a custody gap across handoff, so pulse duration cannot be determined. Calibration and 15-minute logger checks pass.

response.fallback: Record the handoff custody gap and unavailable assay information; reconcile the high-rate record and seek independent review as needed.
response.rationale: Baseline measurement checks pass, while high-rate completeness is false. Missing assay evidence cannot be treated as non-reconciling replicates, so the selector is not established and fallback applies.

reported_values.name: fallback_reason
reported_values.value: Assay replicate reconciliation is unavailable; a trace gap alone does not satisfy the selector.

reported_values.name: M0_pathway_status
reported_values.value: The supplied passing 15-minute logger checks and means satisfy the baseline SCREEN_PASS criterion; the separate high-rate custody gap remains unresolved.

response.scope: Record reconciliation only; neither a pulse nor degradation is established.
